title: 第25章 重情义有血性第26章 找刘家二小姐
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
黄金龙顺着苏冰的目光看去，当看到陈阳的那一刻，瞬间愣住了。
让这个连公司业务都不懂的外行人，当项目部主管？
陈阳也有些意外，愣了一下，下意识看向苏冰，不明白她为什么会突然做出这个决定。
苏冰迎上陈阳的目光，语气平静问：“陈阳，让你顶替赵凯的位置，担任项目部主管，你有问题吗？”
陈阳心中一动，暗自思忖：太好了，这样一来，我正好把昨天向恒哥动手的那赵凯几个属下一起解决了！
他当即点头，语气笃定说：“没问题，我能做好。”
苏冰满意地点了点头，又看向杨婷，语气吩咐道：“小杨，你再去发一份陈阳的任命公告，除了项目部主管之外，再加一个我的专属助理，待遇按公司最高标准来。”
杨婷眼中闪过一丝惊讶，但还是连忙恭敬地应道：“是，总裁。”
说完，她转身再次走出了办公室。
苏冰转头看向黄金龙，语气带着不容置疑的威严：“黄总，接下来，你全力协助陈主管，务必拿下刘家的四星级酒店项目，不能有任何差错。”
黄金龙虽有不满，却不敢表露，只能连忙点头应道：“是，总裁，我一定全力配合。”
苏冰摆了摆手：“你先回去吧，一会让陈主管去找你，对接一下项目的相关事宜。”
黄金龙点了点头，又神色古怪地看了陈阳一眼，眼底满是疑惑和不甘，转身缓缓走出了办公室。
办公室里再次只剩下陈阳和苏冰两人。
陈阳看着苏冰，语气带着几分迟疑：“冰姐，你让我做这个项目部主管，我可能没什么经验，怕做不好，耽误了项目进度。
还有，做你的专属助理，我也没做过，怕达不到你的要求。”
苏冰抬眸看他，语气平淡，却带着一丝笃定：“你不用管其他的，你只要能拿到刘家那个四星级酒店项目，剩下的一切都不用你操心。”
陈阳稍微松了口气，说：“冰姐，我要是能顺利拿下这个项目，有什么好处？”
苏冰挑眉，反问：“你想要什么好处？”
陈阳说：“不知冰姐可以给我什么好处？”

苏冰看着他，心中暗自咬牙：这小子，除了想睡我，还能有什么别的心思？
她深吸一口气，语气干脆说：“你要是能拿下这个项目，你要我怎样都行，任何时候、任何地点、任何姿势，我都配合你。”
陈阳听到这话，心中一阵狂跳，脸颊微微发烫，暗自思忖：这女人怎么这么放得开？
她到底是个什么样的女人？
既然这么随便，又怎么会守住自己的身子，让自己成为她的第一个男人？
苏冰看着他诧异的神色，心中暗自冷哼：小子，是你把我逼得这么不要脸的，你可千万别令我失望，不然，我一定饶不了你！
就在这时，杨婷再次走了进来，恭敬说：“总裁，陈阳的任命公告也已经发出去了，公司上下都已经知晓。”
苏冰点了点头，对着杨婷吩咐道：“带他去办理入职手续，熟悉一下公司的环境，尤其是项目部的情况。”
杨婷看向陈阳，脸上露出礼貌的笑容：“陈先生，这边请。”
content_en:
Golden Dragon followed Su Bing's gaze and was stunned when he saw Chen Yang.
Let this layman, who doesn't even understand the company's business, be the project department director?
Chen Yang was also a little surprised. He was stunned for a moment and looked at Su Bing subconsciously, wondering why she suddenly made this decision.
Su Bing met Chen Yang's gaze and asked in a calm tone: "Chen Yang, I want you to take Zhao Kai's place and serve as the project department manager. Do you have any questions?"
Chen Yang's heart moved and he thought to himself: Great, in this way, I can just take care of Zhao Kai and his subordinates who attacked Brother Heng yesterday!
He nodded immediately and said firmly: "No problem, I can do it well."
Su Bing nodded with satisfaction, looked at Yang Ting again, and said in a tone of voice: "Xiao Yang, please send another appointment announcement for Chen Yang. In addition to the project department director, add one of my exclusive assistants, and the salary will be according to the company's highest standards."
A trace of surprise flashed in Yang Ting's eyes, but she responded quickly and respectfully: "Yes, President."
After saying that, she turned around and walked out of the office again.
Su Bing turned to look at Golden Dragon, and said with unquestionable majesty: "Mr. Huang, next, you will fully assist Director Chen. You must win the Liu family's four-star hotel project without making any mistakes."
Although the golden dragon was dissatisfied, he did not dare to express it. He could only nod quickly and said: "Yes, President, I will fully cooperate."
Su Bing waved her hand: "You should go back first, and I will ask Director Chen to find you later to discuss the project-related matters."
The golden dragon nodded, looked at Chen Yang strangely, his eyes full of doubts and unwillingness, turned around and walked out of the office slowly.
Once again, only Chen Yang and Su Bing were left in the office.
Chen Yang looked at Su Bing and said with a bit of hesitation: "Sister Bing, you asked me to be the director of this project department. I may not have much experience, and I'm afraid that I won't do it well and will delay the progress of the project.
Also, I have never done anything like being your exclusive assistant, for fear that I would not be able to meet your requirements. "
Su Bing raised her eyes to look at him, her tone was calm, but with a hint of certainty: "You don't have to worry about anything else. As long as you can get the Liu family's four-star hotel project, you don't have to worry about the rest."
Chen Yang breathed a sigh of relief and said, "Sister Bing, if I can successfully win this project, what will be the benefits?"
Su Bing raised her eyebrows and asked, "What benefits do you want?"
Chen Yang said: "I wonder what benefits Sister Bing can give me?"
Su Bing looked at him and gritted her teeth secretly: Apart from wanting to sleep with me, what other thoughts could this kid have?
She took a deep breath and said in a straightforward tone: "If you can win this project, I will do whatever you want. I will cooperate with you at any time, in any place, and in any posture."
When Chen Yang heard this, his heart beat wildly, his cheeks became slightly hot, and he thought to himself: How can this woman be so relaxed?
What kind of woman is she?
If he was so casual, how could he protect his body and let himself be her first man?
Su Bing looked at his surprised expression and snorted secretly in her heart: Boy, you are the one who forced me to be so shameless. You must not disappoint me, otherwise, I will definitely not be able to spare you!
At this moment, Yang Ting walked in again and said respectfully: "President, Chen Yang's appointment announcement has been sent out, and everyone in the company is aware of it."
Su Bing nodded and ordered Yang Ting: "Take him to go through the entry procedures and get familiar with the company's environment, especially the project department."
Yang Ting looked at Chen Yang with a polite smile on her face: "Mr. Chen, please come this way."
